decisions.reason: The existing MODIFY captures the new final-stretch focus but leaves obsolete terminal-specific intent and refinement constraints after the client shifts attention from the terminal itself to the right-arm stretch leading into it.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

Thank you for exploring the terminal so thoughtfully. I actually think this helped clarify something for me.

I still think Option 2 from the previous round is my favorite. I don't think the terminal itself is what my eye is focusing on anymore. Instead, I think it's the last portion of the right arm leading into the terminal. I'd love to see if that final stretch can retain just a touch more confidence before it finishes, so the gesture feels like it continues with conviction rather than softening as it approaches the end.

I also think we've reached an exciting point in the project. Rather than continuing to evaluate the capital V in isolation, I'd love to start seeing how this gesture translates into the lowercase v and the É accent. Since the right arm will ultimately define all three, I think seeing them together will help us judge whether we've truly found the architectural language for the entire Vellvé identity.

value_updates.terminal_refinement_focus: The final stretch leading into the terminal must retain confidence and finish with conviction rather than softening
value_updates.evaluation_rule: Evaluate the signature gesture together across the Hero V, second V, and É accent

decisions.reason: The existing MODIFY correctly propagates the broader right-arm gesture but should remove the superseded terminal-only derivation key.
